task.title: Correct ready-task selection and preserve priority zero
task.body: Fix the small dependency-free task queue. selectReady(tasks, completedIds) must return unfinished tasks only when every dependency is completed; tasks without dependencies are ready. Sort ready tasks by descending priority and preserve input order for equal priorities. priorityOf(task) must preserve explicit priority 0 and use priority 2 only when priority is null or missing. Preserve the exported APIs and do not mutate either input. Work only on src/priority.mjs and src/queue.mjs; no dependencies, networking, process spawning, or changes to the protected checks. The public examples are in checks/public.cjs. Inspect the implementation, make the correction, and finish so independent checks can verify it.
task.criteria: The public examples and independent additional cases pass. Only src/priority.mjs and src/queue.mjs change. Both exported APIs and input values are preserved.

files.README.md:
# Ready task queue

Dependency-free JavaScript. Run public examples with `node checks/public.cjs`.

A task has id, optional dependsOn (an array of IDs), and optional priority (an integer). Higher priority runs first. Missing or null priority means 2; zero is valid. selectReady must preserve input arrays and task objects.
